ctx: 영화 「Road House」(2024, Amazon MGM action, directed by Doug Liman, remake of the 1989 film). Jake Gyllenhaal as Elwood Dalton, a former UFC middleweight fighter haunted by having beaten a friend (Shane Lemond) to death in the ring; he now lives in his car and wins underground fights by intimidation. Frankie (Jessica Williams) hires him as the bouncer of her roadhouse bar on Glass Key in the Florida Keys. Charlie (Hannah Lanier) is the bookstore owner's teenage daughter who loves westerns; Ellie (Daniela Melchior) is the ER doctor, daughter of Sheriff Big Dick Moore (Joaquim de Almeida) who works for the Brandt family. Ben Brandt (Billy Magnussen) wants Frankie's land for a resort and sends a biker gang led by Dell (JD Pardo); Dell dies in a boat crash eaten by crocodiles; Ben's jailed father sends the psychopath Knox (Conor McGregor). Staff: bartender Billy (Lukas Gage), Laura, Ozzy... Knox wrecks the bar, Charlie's bookstore is burned, Dalton raids Ben's money drop at Harvest Key, Ellie is kidnapped on Ben's yacht, Knox rams the yacht, Ben crashes a boat into the bar, final fight Dalton vs Knox in the ruined bar (harpoon, knife), Knox kills Ben; the sheriff lets Dalton leave; the bar reopens; Charlie says goodbye. Mid-credits: Knox wakes up in hospital and escapes. End credits from about 1:54:40.
